svg.aria-label: Still being built. Three more, in progress. Each status says exactly how far along it is. Planket: Web app live · stores next. A shared calendar that shows when everyone is free, and sends a plan in three taps. CareerOS: Private pilot. Notices when you ship, and drafts résumé and LinkedIn lines from evidence it can cite. HACKFAM: Prototype · building. Event discovery and teammate matching for hackathons, CTFs and game jams.
